name: t-0hmura
description: A skill plugin that lets AI agents draw chemical structures and reaction mechanisms with curved arrows. From a description of an organic reaction, a textbook reaction name, a hand-drawn image or a paper, the agent makes the figure as PNG, SVG and CDXML files.
